label: GO step near the end of the episode (low predicted value)
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2), and almost only in the last ~10 trials of a 100-trial episode (trials 90-99 hold 98% of mass). The model value head falls as the episode nears its end, so the best observed predicate is GO & value < 4 (dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.94). GO & ep_trial >= 90 has recall 0.99 but precision 0.31. Magnitude grows as value falls: GO & value < 3 has precision 0.80 and covers 49% of mass with only 32% of active steps. So this is an end-of-episode / low-value timer at choice time, not a task-variable detector. Weak modulation: higher rate after a common previous transition (1.4x; adding prev_common == 1 gives F1 0.72 but drops mass recall to 0.78), and a high rate on the rare GO steps after a D1 fixation error (in_rew == -1, 6% of mass). Choice, state, reward and stay matter little. Uses no future variables.
